summary: Retest of iteration_10 fixes. Backend 9/9 pass: pro_welcome is sent on the first move into active/trialing (incomplete->active via subscription.updated sends exactly one; active/past_due->active, trialing->active and replay send nothing more; unpaid->active calls notify again but the idem key blocks the second e-mail). A trial start includes 'Your free trial runs until DD Month YYYY.' Both e-mails were really sent (status sent) to delivered+t11member@resend.dev. Admin/owner see full e-mails in subscriptions and payments; analyst sees d***@resend.dev and the full address appears nowhere in the response. A campaign send is refused with the managed-provider message while marketing e-mail is off. The preview shows the trial sentence and the '01 December 2026' date. Frontend at 390px all pass: the phone card is now a DIV; member-open opens member-panel and 'Open full profile' opens /admin/users?open=<id> with the drawer; sub-cancel and sub-resume open sub-confirm; pay-refund opens refund-confirm; coupon-off opens coupon-confirm; camp-send opens camp-confirm; no button-inside-button warning; the canceled row has no empty chip. Regression: on Admin Users at 390px the card is still a button and tapping it opens the drawer. Desktop subscriptions table, panel and confirm still work.

minor.issue: prev_status 'unpaid' (also paused/incomplete_expired) is not in the guard list, so the welcome block runs again on unpaid->active. The idem key stops a second e-mail, so nothing is visible to users. Optional: add 'unpaid' and 'paused' to the guard.

critical_code_review_comments: The canceled-row actions column still renders a zero-width empty <span> inside .a-rowcard-chips. It has no visible chip but adds a flex gap. It is cosmetic only.
Optional: widen the pro_welcome prev_status guard (unpaid/paused) so the code does not rely only on the idem key.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 390px in-row flows + Users regression + desktop spot check)
